messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty fired INC-923817 for service=inference-frontend (eu-prod). symptom=high tail latency >500ms, p95 spike. routing to oncall.

Priya (oncall): ack INC-923817. I'm on it — checking traces and recent deploys. @Ethan can you grab traces for the last 5m? :mag:

Ethan: pulling traces 3165283990-3165284000. initial look: embedder pods p95 jump, 500-800ms. No obvious model-level errors.

Maya: I see a bunch of KV cache evictions in the same timeframe from kvcache-metrics. Could be a kvcache storm after a variant push yesterday. Anyone rolled out embedder-lite recently?

Priya (oncall): Not me. @Carlos did we have any image pushes or infra changes? Also Lina, any customer reports so far?

Lina (support): Got two timeouts reported in last 10m. customerA low-rps, customerB higher and complaining of intermittent 504s. Opening support ticket TKT-7782 and notifying their SE.

Carlos: Checking autoscaler logs — looks like new pods failed to come up: ImagePullBackOff for embedder-lite:v3. Looks like the image push to eu-registry failed and autoscaler couldn't create replacements.

Ethan: ran: kubectl -n inference get pods | grep embedder
```
embedder-lite-7f9c   CrashLoopBackOff   1/1   3m
embedder-lite-84ab   ImagePullBackOff   0/1   2m
```
Ethan: I'm doing a rolling restart of the embedder-lite daemonset to force re-pull.

Priya (oncall): Initiating quick canary rollback: set routing model_variant=stable on /v1/generate for 10%. Pushing now, will monitor p95 and error rate.

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: INC-923817 acknowledged by Priya (oncall). Escalation window active until 3165284200.

Maya: After the restart and the rollback p95 on canary dropped from ~680ms to ~120ms. Error rate down from 3.2% -> 0.4% on canary.

Priya (oncall): Good — marking this as mitigated for now. I'll keep monitoring for 30m. Handoff to Maya for RCA and follow-up with infra on image push reliability. @Maya can you take ownership?

Maya: Taking ownership. I'll open an RCA (RCA-564) and coordinate with infra to look at registry replication and auto-retry for image pulls.

Lina (support): Customer outreach: emailing customerB with incident summary and mitigation steps, ETA ~45m for formal note.

Priya (oncall): Closing page as resolved for now. Will re-open if we see regressions. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Ethan: adding a short log excerpt to RCA — ImagePush error: "manifest unknown: manifest unknown" from eu-registry at 2026-03-17T15:40:21Z.

Carlos: I'll follow up on CI that pushed embedder-lite:v3, adding a verification step.

incident-bot: INC-923817 marked resolved by Priya (oncall).
